hatch-ws-client: diagnostic client for the daemon http-api; its clap args (--http_api_url, --path, --verb, --subscribe_path) and string refs make these the highest-confidence daemon routes. JARVIS_WS_ADDR default ws://127.0.0.1:18789/
hatch: /hatch/* are stefi-proxy routes (http://localhost/hatch/...); /api/* /fs/* also served on daemon http-api (subset string-confirmed). Glued literals mean some multi-segment routes may be truncated.
ingress-rev-proxy: internet-facing Noise_XX reverse proxy; this is the EXTERNAL route table it proxies. /api/permissions/* family = Sentinel permission surface; /v1/vault/migration/* = vault migration; /v1/ssh/operator/* = SSH access control.
spawnd: no routes served; only client-side substring refs (/fs/read, /v1/noise).
_method: strings -a -n 4 + manual curation; Rust literals glue without NUL so raw tokens were split at route-prefix boundaries and verified by byte context; no methods or liveness claimed
